newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower after lackluster session.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower after lackluster session.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures gave up some of the gains made Monday and settled an uneventful session weaker, market sources said.

A lack of follow through to the upside discouraged today's early buyers, who bailed out and pressured the market lower. Floor sources noted mixed selling, but volume was light at an estimated 900 lots.
Most-active January closed below 100.00 cents a lb and is seen drifting around the key prices as it awaits news to gauge its next move.
The contract settled at 99.60, down 0.75, having ranged from 100.50 to 99.25. The back months ended off 1.60 to 0.80.
Nearby support was pegged at 97.50 in January and resistance at an uptrend line at 102.50.

Analysts said the market is trading in a sideways pattern but the outlook was to the downside. Celeste Georgakis, a vice president with Dean Witter, said a quiet cash prices was keeping a lid on activity in the futures market.
Temperatures across the Florida citrus belt are expected to remain below average but they not low enough to damage fruit.
